282:t_1:3.en: ～ Jupiter Region, $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ Base ～

282:t_1:4.en:
$$リンダ$$
「...Good work, everyone. I've heard most of the details from $$スメラギ$$'s report.」

282:t_1:5.en:
$$イアン$$
「Thanks for coming out to meet us, $$リンダ$$.」

282:t_1:6.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「It's been so long, Mom!」

282:t_1:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So $$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s base was in orbit among Jupiter's moons.」

282:t_1:8.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Building GN Drives takes a high-gravity environment.」

282:t_1:9.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Helium-3 harvesting fleets come to Jupiter too, so besides our base there are several facilities here built for that purpose.」

282:t_1:10.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「So even if it's a meager one, this is a human settlement too.」

282:t_1:11.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Still, it's a relief. We were able to get supplies like food here.」

282:t_1:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...I understand how you feel, $$シン$$. Considering what $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ has done in the past, relying on them...」

282:t_1:14.en:
$$シン$$
「That's not it...! It's $$イアン$$ I can't accept!」

282:t_1:15.en:
$$イアン$$
「W-what is it, all of a sudden?」

282:t_1:16.en:
$$シン$$
「Why are $$イアン$$ and $$リンダ$$ married!? I can't accept a 25-year age gap!」

282:t_1:19.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I can't believe this is allowed...」

282:t_1:20.en:
$$シン$$
「R-right, $$バナージ$$...! You think so too, don't you!?」

282:t_1:21.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「What are you two talking about...」

282:t_1:22.en:
$$クェス$$
「It's so pathetic, guys getting jealous.」

282:t_1:23.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「You got angry about the same thing before too, $$シン$$.」

282:t_1:25.en:
$$キラ$$
「You really hold a grudge, $$シン$$.」

282:t_1:26.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Having a strong will can be a pain at times.」

282:t_1:27.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「I agree with $$カミーユ$$. ...Come on, $$シン$$, stop saying such rude things.」

282:t_1:29.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Heh... I guess getting back to the Solar System somehow has let everyone relax a little.」

282:t_1:30.en:
$$刹那$$
「No wonder. It's been nonstop tension ever since the $$時空震動$$ at $$第２新東京市$$.」

282:t_1:31.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「But even if it was by chance, coming to the Jupiter base is perfect timing.」

282:t_1:32.en:
$$リンダ$$
「With the $$イノベイド$$s helping, the adjustments on that thing have reached the final stage.」

282:t_1:33.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「So you're using their ability to receive $$脳量子波$$.」

282:t_1:34.en:
$$イアン$$
「All right... Then let's get started on the finishing work right away.」

282:t_1:35.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What are you talking about?」

282:t_1:36.en:
$$刹那$$
「To explain it, $$バナージ$$... We'd like to borrow your power and the $$ユニコーン$$'s.」

282:t_1:38.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That's right. The operation data from that unit, which shares the same concept, should be a useful reference too.」

282:t_1:40.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If I can be of use.」

282:t_1:41.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「...Well then, while $$刹那$$ and $$ティエリア$$ are working, I'll take some private time.」

282:t_1:42.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Have a good time, $$ロックオン$$.」

282:t_1:43.en:
$$クェス$$
「Hey, what is it? What's 'private time'?」

282:t_1:45.en:
$$マリー$$
「Heh... from that look, it seems you two felt $$ロックオン$$'s heart as well.」

282:t_1:46.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「It's just as you imagine. Someone precious to $$ロックオン$$ works at this base as one of the staff.」

282:t_1:50.en: ～ Inside the $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ Base ～

282:t_1:51.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'm so moved that the Jupiter base has a big bath. It's my first time in ages taking a bath without worrying about water.」

282:t_1:52.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Even if it's to save water and energy, I never thought all the female crew would end up bathing at once...」

282:t_1:53.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But it's kind of strange. Only Earth and the Moon come in twos, while every other planet in the Solar System has just one.」

282:t_1:54.en:
$$ラルク$$
「The story is that the other planets are what you get when the Solar Systems of the so-called $$蒼の地球$$ and the $$翠の地球$$ merged.」

282:t_1:55.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Hmm... So it's only around Earth that the parallel worlds don't overlap.」

282:t_1:58.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノリコ$$... The biggest difference between you and $$ノノリリ$$ was that $$ノノリリ$$ had a nice body, but...」

282:t_1:61.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But my Big Sis and $$ユング#pilot$$ were even bigger up top and gorgeous!」

282:t_1:62.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No, no, you're just being modest.」

282:t_1:63.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノリコ$$'s fair, soft skin flushed pink from the steam of the bath... it was simply irresistible!」

282:t_1:64.en:
$$チコ$$
「That's enough. The guys don't know how to react.」

282:t_1:67.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「N-no way...! Did everyone hear that!?」

282:t_1:68.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Hear it? ... You're the one who started talking on your own.」

282:t_1:70.en:
$$アルト$$
「I-I didn't hear anything! Really, I never heard a word about pink or anything!」

282:t_1:71.en:
$n
「$$アルト$$... If I'm the silent type, you're the silent pervert.」

282:t_1:72.en:
$n
「And if you drop the silent act like I did, you'll just be a plain pervert...!」

282:t_1:73.en:
$$アルト$$
「What are you talking about, you!」

282:t_1:74.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't strike back the moment you get the chance, $n.」

282:t_1:75.en:
$$エイミー$$
「...Did $$レド$$ hear it too?」

282:t_1:76.en:
$$レド$$
「Of course. Gathering intelligence is the foundation of tactics.」

282:t_1:77.en:
$n
「$$レド$$... So you've already dropped the silent act.」

282:t_1:79.en:
$$レド$$
「...I don't quite understand, but is a status report on the opposite sex bathing really that unusual?」

282:t_1:81.en:
$$レド$$
「In the $$人類銀河同盟$$, there is no distinction between men and women when bathing.」

282:t_1:84.en:
$$ボス$$
「F-for the first time ever... I actually envy $$レド$$...」

282:t_1:85.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Supplementary explanation. In the Alliance, the concept of sex difference applies only under specific circumstances.」

リンクス.evidence: Mileina's 「リンクス君」 for Banagher (surname Links, glossary バナージ・リンクス); Banagher answers at t_1:19; no bare token in the sheet

uncertain: 282:t_1:8: 太陽炉 written as plain 'GN Drives' (no token for 太陽炉; the ＧＮドライヴ token is a different Japanese term)
282:t_1:32: 例のもの rendered 'that thing' (probably the Unicorn-related project revealed at t_1:36-38)
282:t_1:71-72,77: ムッツリ/ムッツリスケベ/脱ムッツリ rendered 'silent type' / 'silent pervert' / 'drop the silent act'; no established English term
282:t_1:61: Noriko's お姉さま = 'my Big Sis' (Kazumi, following the settled Nono rendering)
282:t_1:45: 二人も read as Marie addressing Marida and Quess ('you two ... as well')
282:t_1:56,65,66: dot rows use nine dots per settled rule rather than the six-dot Tengoku text
